per_faculty.note: webapp/reasoning_transitive_chat.py: BRAIN_TRANSITIVE_LESION=1 forces the reused keystone chase (webapp.gnw_multistep_deliberation.multistep_chase) to run on the GNW workspace built with its assembly self-recurrence ZEROED (webapp/gnw_deliberation.py::_get_bridge(seed, lesion=True)) -- the SAME lesion mechanism `gnw-multistep-deliberation` already uses. Collapses ignition at hop 0, so a genuinely-derivable non-adjacent 'does A precede D?' can no longer chain past the direct-fact check and flips from derived=True to an honest abstain. The ADJACENT-pair short-circuit (query_patient(agent,relation)==target, a plain recall, not the chase) is UNAFFECTED by this lesion -- isolating the cut to the multi-hop contribution specifically, not the underlying recall primitive. Confirmed present in source (webapp/reasoning_transitive_chat.py).
